definition / rationale: log1p(amount): amounts are heavy-tailed (max 5.5k vs median 88).
log1p(account age in days): early-life accounts are riskier, effect is strongest at small ages.
sqrt(transactions in 24h): dampens the extreme counts (max 113).
Percentile rank of the amount in the training distribution (robust to outliers).
Percentile rank of the distance in the training distribution.
txns_1h / (txns_24h + 1): share of the day's activity that falls in the last hour (burst).
txns_24h - txns_1h: activity before the current hour (baseline level).
txns_1h / ((txns_24h + 1) / 24): current hourly rate relative to the 24h average rate (acceleration).
1 if 4 or more transactions in the last hour.
failed logins / (txns_24h + 1): authentication friction per transaction.
amount x txns_1h: money moved in a burst (exposure proxy).
z-score of log amount within the merchant category (is this big FOR a restaurant / jeweller?).
z-score of log amount within the channel.

amount / (account age + 1): large amounts on young accounts.

1 if amount above the training 95th percentile.
max(merchant risk, ip risk): the worst of the two.
merchant risk x ip risk: both elevated at once.
|merchant risk - ip risk|: disagreement between the two scores.
1 if both risk scores above their training 75th percentile.
